question: Who among the following is NOT a Nobel laureate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manoj Das**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb90c3647c276e117dc17fb6439410dad00fafe8f511a89c38f32cba7de65df.png] **__

__
 
• **Manoj Das:** He was **awarded the Saraswati Samman and awarded Padma Shri in 2001, **Padma Bhusan in 2020.

 
 
• **​**Indian author, he wrote in Odia and English.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar: 1983** for physical processes of importance to the structure and evolution of the stars.
 
• **Amartya Sen**: **1998 **for his contributions to welfare economics.
 
• **Venkatraman Ramakrishnan: 2009 **in Chemistry.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• About Nobel Prize: Nobel Prize five in number until 1969, when a sixth was added.
 
• The proposed by the Swedish inventor and industrialist Alfred Nobel.
 
 
• From Stockholm:
 

 
 
• The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences confers the prizes for physics, chemistry, and economics.
 
• The Karolinska Institute confers the prize for physiology or medicine, and
 
• The Swedish Academy confers the prize for literature.
 

 
 
• The Norwegian Nobel Committee based in Oslo confers the prize for peace.
